newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African platinum shares surge on metal price.
newsitem.headline: S.African platinum shares surge on metal price.

text.p: South African platinum shares surged on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) on Thursday on the back of a sharply higher platinum price.
Platinum was trading almost $20 higher on Thursday and was last bid at $369.75 dollars an ounce.
Rustenburg Platinum Holdings Ltd (Rusplats) was the biggest gainer up 450 cents to 68.00 rand from its close on Wednesday at 63.50 rand.
Some 239,200 shares changed hands by 0845 GMT in transactions worth over 16 million rand.
Impala Platinum Holdings Ltd gained 300 cents to 49.50 a share with 72,700 shares worth 3.66 million rand trading by 0845 GMT.
Anglo American Platinum Corp Ltd shares were up 50 cents at 26.50 rand.
Northam Platinum Ltd was the biggest mover in percentage terms on the JSE up 16.67 percent to 2.50 rand a share.
Lebowa Platinum Mines Ltd traded 20 cents higher at 2.62 a share and Potgietersrust Platinum Ltd (PPRust) was up 75 cents at 20.75 rand.
